messages:
alec-ml: Heads up  found a consistent degradation on the new q6b-int8 candidate for the 'news-to-brief' prompt slice after onboarding evals (~4.2 ROUGE-L). Looks reproducible across 3 seeds.

zoe-curation: Thanks. What promptset and dedupe did we use? could be something we stripped out during dedupe.

alec-ml: Using promptset news_brief_v1 (8.6k examples). We applied paraphrase dedupe at threshold 0.82 last Tuesday to clean seedbank.

rahul-labelops: If dedupe removed paraphrase anchors that were used to craft gold summaries, that could explain brittleness. We can run a focused microgolden refresh for that slice.

marta-eng: Also want to rule out kernel numeric drift. I'll run an isolated A/B on the slice with identical decoding settings and register token-diff traces.

alec-ml: Eval run command: 
```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model q6b-int8-candidate --dataset datasets/news_brief_v1.jsonl
  --slice news_to_brief --metric rougeL --batch 12 --seed 7 --decoding beam=3
```

eval-bot: Deploy metadata: q6b-int8-candidate built 2024-06-20T11:02:01Z. Perf 580 tok/s, KV 0.95GB.

zoe-curation: Proposed plan: sample 300 microgolden (150 golden anchors + 150 review) stratified by article length and named-entity density. Also create a 'restore list' of near-dupes removed by dedupe for comparison.

rahul-labelops: Can do. Requesting +350 label units for 48h to avoid queueing. Will include instructions: tag HALL (hallucination), REP (missing key points), ORDER (misordered facts).

marta-eng: I'll kick off the A/B baseline vs candidate on the microgolden and also toggle strict fp16 math flag to compare numeric paths.

alec-ml: I'll add a small harness patch to log top-5 token diffs and alignment spans; will open PR to evals repo.

eval-bot: AB test scheduled: ab-news-20240620, shards=3. Expect results in ~30m.

zoe-curation: I'll open a tracker RDW-8392 and attach sampling seeds + restore whitelist. Will also note labeling rubric.

rahul-labelops: Label instructions (short):
- mark REP if key bullet missing
- mark HALL if invented detail
- mark LEN if summary truncation
(Full doc linked in RDW-8392)

alec-ml: Uploaded 40 failure examples + 40 matched controls to the ticket for quick review. :eyes:

eval-bot: AB results: baseline (q8b-fp16) > candidate by 4.1 rougeL on news_to_brief slice (p=0.009). Token-diff logs: /evals/ab-news-20240620/logs.tgz

marta-eng: Pattern seems numeric. I'll run a kernel bisect and a forced fp16 run to isolate.

zoe-curation: Given that, let's proceed with the microgolden relabel and a short quant calibration sweep (recalibrate with longer-context importance). Do both in parallel.

rahul-labelops: Label batch queued. ETA artifacts ~36h. Will post progress updates here. :white_check_mark:

alec-ml: Thanks team. Action items: (1) zoe create RDW ticket + attach seeds, (2) rahul schedule label batch, (3) marta run kernel bisect + fp16 check, (4) alec run post-relabel evals.

zoe-curation: RDW-8392 created and pinned. Added restore whitelist and sampling script.

rahul-labelops: Labelers started; short standup updates incoming.

marta-eng: I'll post bisect findings when ready.

alec-ml: Leaving sample set in the ticket. Will follow up once labels return.

eval-bot: Thread ab-news-20240620 closed for results.
